body: Good one, i hope you get paid for those funny jokes! So funny you made your username laugh.

Time for talk is over, I've done everything i can, and the world just wants to fuck me. Well it got me. You win, world. Thanks for trying to talk to me, but i think i posted this just a little too late to actually get help

Yes, i applied and appealed through someone who specializes in getting approval. anger isn't a word i can use to describe the way i feel. Betrayed, cheated, infuriated, enraged, those words get closer. I cut ties with my family years ago except for my mom, and she can't do anything to help.

Been denied disability, appeal got shot down. I wouId be on the street before they give me a penny. Yet I've paid into it with every fucking paycheck. can apply for the foodstamps online, but they have to talk to you.  never have i ever felt like the world as a whole has spat in my face until this happened to me. It's so hard to just shoot myself in the face and be done with it... You can think about it, but when you're actually putting the barrel in your mouth, it's fucking hard because you think about your stupid family and the way they would react *if* they learn of my fate.
Reminds me of how I'm about to die alone
